'''Algae Soup''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].  It may also be dropped by a [[Mutant Grub]] (10% chance).

'''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - Algae Soup sells for {{Price|100}} and 4 [[Green Algae]] sell for {{Price|60}}.

==Bundles==
Algae Soup is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Algae Soup is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Algae Soup is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt069.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Algae Soup may be requested by [[Slimejack]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
